_comment: hrse#1546 — the versioned source of a UserPromptSubmit hook that lives
in the UNTRACKED ~/.claude/settings.json.
WHY USER LEVEL. AC1 is 'every prompt in every session'. A project
.claude/settings.json fires only for sessions whose cwd is inside that
project, and measured 2026-09-05: hrse had 2 UserPromptSubmit hooks,
harmonic-forge 1, ~/.claude/settings.json zero. The session that
surfaced this issue had no LANE — i.e. was running outside hrse — which
is exactly the session a project-level hook cannot reach.
WHY THIS FILE EXISTS. The live file is untracked, so it has no review
and no history. This copy restores both without changing where the hook
fires or what it does. If the two ever disagree, this one is the intent
and the live one is the fact — reconcile toward this.
WHY A BARE echo AND NOT A SCRIPT. A UserPromptSubmit hook blocks the
prompt on exit code 2. An inline echo of a literal string has no failure
mode that reaches it: no file read, no interpreter start, no stdin
consumed. AC3 ('never blocks a prompt') therefore holds by construction
rather than by care. A python3 script would be the natural symmetry with
expand_lane_shorthand.py and is strictly worse here — it can fail to
import, and it costs an interpreter start on every single prompt.
WHY IT READS NO STDIN. The other two hooks on this event do: the
conditional reminder pipes the prompt payload through a bare grep, and
expand_lane_shorthand.py parses it. Each hook is its own process with
its own stdin, but a third stdin-consuming hook is the one way this
could have interfered, so it deliberately consumes none. That is AC4.
WHY THE TEXT IS NOT REWORDED. It is the operator's own sentence,
verbatim, because it is the one that demonstrably works. A paraphrase —
capitalised, politened, expanded into a rule — is an untested change to
the only part of this that was ever validated. AC2.
COST, MEASURED NOT ESTIMATED (AC5). Via the Anthropic count_tokens
endpoint on 2026-09-05, subtracting a one-character envelope floor:
13 tokens on claude-opus-5 and claude-sonnet-5, 10 on
claude-haiku-4-5. 52 characters. A chars/4 estimate would have said 13
— right for Opus by coincidence and wrong for Haiku, which is why the
AC asks for a real number.
INSTALL: merge the `hooks` object below into ~/.claude/settings.json,
appending to any existing UserPromptSubmit array rather than replacing
it.

hooks.command: echo '{"hookSpecificOutput": {"hookEventName": "UserPromptSubmit", "additionalContext": "use the todolist widget so I can track your progress"}}' || true
